verdict.rationale: Fin has a dedicated voice channel: a 'Deploy Fin Voice' guide, and Fin Voice 2 runs on a latency-optimized model. That model is 'grounded in your knowledge base, and trained to apply your specific policies on every call', and Fin can be deployed across every channel from the same training. Phone support also sits in the same inbox as other channels. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that Procedures, actions and data connectors run on voice calls the same as in chat; details on speech recognition and synthesis quality; independent or hands-on corroboration of voice performance.
